values: For the duvet cover and every pillowcase including attached fastenings: normal machine wash, maximum 60°C; fasten the duvet cover before washing. Line dry or tumble dry at maximum 80°C. Iron main fabric at maximum 200°C, avoiding fastenings. Do not bleach or dry-clean.

For the duvet cover and every pillowcase including attached fastenings: normal machine wash, maximum 40°C; fasten the duvet cover before washing. Line dry or tumble dry at maximum 60°C. Iron main fabric at maximum 110°C, avoiding fastenings. Do not bleach or dry-clean.
